text: Hatred does not cease through hatred at any time. Hatred ceases through love. This is an unalterable law.
author: Gautama Buddha

archive.text: I ought to be thy Adam, but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed.
archive.author: Mary Shelley

archive.text: Why do you stay in prison, when the door is so wide open?
archive.author: Rumi

archive.text: Let us revere, let us worship, but erect and open-eyed, the highest, not the lowest; the future, not the past!
archive.author: Charlotte Perkins Gilman

archive.text: The shifts of fortune test the reliability of friends.
archive.author: Cicero

archive.text: Drink your tea slowly and reverently, as if it is the axis on which the world earth revolves.
archive.author: Thich Nhat Hanh

archive.text: Let the beauty of what you love be what you do.
archive.author: Rumi
